NODE_ENV.description: Environment mode. Set to 'production' for Vercel deployments.

DATABASE_URL.description: PostgreSQL connection string to Supabase. MUST use the session pooler (port 5432), not transaction mode (port 6543). Use format: postgresql://user:password@db.*.pooler.supabase.com:5432/postgres

SESSION_SECRET.description: Session signing secret for NextAuth. Generate with: openssl rand -base64 32

ENCRYPTION_KEY.description: AES-256-GCM key for PII field encryption. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32. CRITICAL: Once set, this key cannot change without losing all encrypted data.

NEXTAUTH_URL.description: Base URL for the application (e.g., https://myuno-final.vercel.app)

CRON_SECRET.description: Bearer token for protecting /api/cron/* routes. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 24

RESEND_API_KEY.description: API key for Resend email service. Optional: if unset, emails log to console instead.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Email sender address. Defaults to Resend's test domain (onboarding@resend.dev). Once your domain is verified in Resend, set to your custom domain.

CONTENT_REVIEW_GATE_ENABLED.description: Enable/disable content review deployment gate. Set to 'true' to block deployments with review-pending content.
